title: Portuguese Stir Fry with Oats
description: A hearty and earthy Portuguese-inspired stir fry with oats and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add lentils, tomato paste, and stir-fry sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in oats and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
